test_title: PYST 21: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 18th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

The manager insisted that the files be reviewed (1)/ before they are submitted (2)/ to the committee (3)/ tomorrow morning. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence lies in the incorrect verb tense in part **2**.
 
• The clause "**before they are submitted**" uses the present tense "**are**," which is inconsistent with the subjunctive mood triggered by "**insisted**."
 
• In formal English, when a verb like "insisted" is used, the subjunctive mood requires the base form of the verb "**be**" instead of "are."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**before they be submitted**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The manager insisted that the files be reviewed before they be submitted to the committee tomorrow morning."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "The manager insisted that the files be reviewed"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not need any changes.
 
• **3: "to the committee"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not need any changes.
 
• **4: "tomorrow morning"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not need any changes.
